item.content:encoded: The KTE designation implies that 953 is (or at least the GOC believes it is) related to the Factory. This is an interesting tidbit I don't see being expanded. I have to believe this was a deliberate choice, so I'd love some clarification on how a magical fox girl is related to a possibly sentient building of nightmarish mass production. The two entities seem so antithetical. Disregard I can't read.

item.content:encoded:
We (me and Clef) talked about this project 4 years ago, and the result came out too late(This is basically my fault). And I am very thankful for you not to forget it.

Our fist talk was in 2014. And there was some working going on, and then it was at a standstill becuase some guys participated went dormant (for various reasons) and I suffered for suffer from severe depression. Finally, we(SCP-KO) made some intermediate results in 2017.

I cannot translate all of works in SCP-KO into English, and this Serpent Hand article is summarizing those results. I was so worried about how Clef would respond on this article, as he is original author of 953, and we couldn't contact for 4 years. I'm very, very grateful and finally feeling some easy for seeing Clef's post.

So when SCP Korea told me that a bunch of folks over there had set up an entire Joseon-Era SCP-953 canon, I admit I got a little giddy.

I'd love to see this work tightened for grammar, and perhaps for prose, because I feel like there are a lot of stories to be told about our favorite murder-fox.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Thank you for nice evaluation.
And expanding 953's narrative was really one of my three intentions of this article.

Umm, but H. was not raised by 953. She was raised by humans including Master Flowery Pond. 953 did nothing but givng her birth.

Indeed, she is not omnicidal killer. Rather, her motivation and actions are similar to those of a normal(?) serial killer, who hides in the shade and wants to avoid public attention, in order to make her killing easy. (well there is that notorious furry massacare, but I think it was very exceptional case, and so is the Calamity of 1795 mentioned in this SH article) She never wants an apocalyptic event or social panic occers. What she really wants is continuing her cannibalism forever. Thus human society, which is her human-cattle farm should keep going well to some least degreee.

Though she is not omnicidal killer, 953 is still psychopath. Even her daughter thinks so. 953 is not specially malevolent. It's normal to kill and eat people for demon fox. It's their racial characteristics. H. is very rare exception, and one exception is many enough, I think.

item.content:encoded: This actually gives 953 some characterization aside from "lol furries suck". For that alone, I would upvote, but everything else about this is great too— particularly the idea that H. is 953's kid. The fact that she was capable of raising young automatically shows that she's not an omnicidal psychopath.
